name: deskworlds
description: Living worlds for macOS and Hyprland desktops: Riverbed, Coral reef, and Betta.

scripts.check: node --check serve.mjs && for f in scenes/*/src/*.js scenes/shared/*.js ui/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.check:linux: python3 -m py_compile linux/*.py && python3 -m unittest discover -s linux/tests && bash -n linux/install.sh linux/uninstall.sh
scripts.test: node ui/tests/gallery.mjs && node scenes/riverscape/tests/fish-behavior.mjs && node scenes/riverscape/tests/render-policy.mjs && node scenes/riverscape/tests/plant-budget.mjs && node scenes/reefscape/tests/behavior.mjs && node scenes/reefscape/tests/assets.mjs && node scenes/reefscape/tests/locomotion.mjs && node scenes/reefscape/tests/anemone.mjs && node scenes/bettascape/tests/food.mjs
